data.one_liner: A lightweight widget that displays real‑time FPS and optional stats for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: StatsFl wraps a child widget and renders an overlay showing frames per second, with configurable size, alignment, and text visibility. It can be toggled on or off and supports custom FPS targets.
use_when: You need quick visual feedback on rendering performance during development
You want to monitor FPS in a production build for diagnostics
You want a simple, dependency‑free overlay without external packages
avoid_when: You require advanced profiling tools like timeline traces or GPU usage
You need to integrate with a custom analytics or logging system
strengths: Easy to add via a single widget
weaknesses: Only provides FPS, no deeper profiling
No built‑in persistence or export of data
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, wrap root widget with StatsFl
